cases.long_description: I was walking outside and this huge bright green light caught my attention. It made me stop in my tracks. It could not have been more then a few hundred feet off the ground and was very large. It was completely silent. Came from the northeast, flew in front of me about 500 feet. Was moving very fast. It then started to slow down and did a hairpin turn. Half way threw the turn it was like a sling shot and sped across the sky back towards the east. As it was flying away from me I could actually see the shape of it then. It was out of my view within 10 seconds. This thing did not make a sound, the lights stayed a consistent green. Did not flash or blink. The one thing I noticed was after it accelerated after the hairpin turn, every dog in the neighborhood both inside and out were barking. I did not have my phone because I was only going outside for a minute.

cases.long_description: While driving north to Saugerties from Kingston, NY on State Route 9W traveling about 50-60 mph. I was approaching town of Glenerie, I witnessed what seemed like a very bright star in the distance . As I drove and observed it, it appeared to get brighter and then lower and then much closer. I could see it floating or hovering dropping in altitude. I thought perhaps I was speeding. I looked down at the speedometer and I was going about 30mph and slowing down dramatically as I observed the “ bright star “ like object floating/hovering low in the sky diagonally infront of me. Then it’s like it saw me seeing it and then it came rapidly towards my truck .In my shock and awe of this object I then tried to reach for my phone to take video . The craft was just about over me and I saw underneath it. It had 2 blue and 1 green like wingtip lights. 3 distinct stark white light circles under it that somewhat illuminated the rest of the craft which was bulbish/rounded in the shadow on top but the 2 blue and 1green light were like 3 wings or appendages -It changed direction and that bright golden light was very bright and facing me. I was very shaken and tried to record. As it approached me/my truck the phone dropped out of my hand and somehow turned itself off. It continued to hover/float diagonally above me again and I did not pull over, I kept driving also seeing it in my rear view mirror. The object kept floating low and then was gone. I drove away completely perplexed as to what I just witnessed. I checked The video as soon as I parked . It was extremely short. I attached it and was able to pull some still photos which I also attached.

The night was dark and moonless, a perfect evening to observe the heavens above which is exactly what I was doing from the comfort of our hot tub. I had turned off the lights in the house that would detract from my view this evening and had been outside for about 15 minutes soaking and watching random aircraft flying the regular pattern. As I was looking south I noticed motion in the sky to my right at about 2 o’clock and saw what I first believed to be aircraft moving west to east. They were lined up single file and as more appeared it was clear that these weren’t conventional aircraft or even aircraft at all. I was taken aback and ran in the house to grab my wife to corroborate my sighting, which she did. The objects were flying in single file with the exact same spacing and as straight as a string and did so for approximately 5 minutes. We estimate there were at least 100 brightly shining objects observed all moving west to east and I saw the first in line and the last. It gets better. The objects when almost directly south of our house one by one completely disappeared from the sky as though they had flown through an open door. The line of objects stayed spaced and straight until the last 6 or 8 which appeared to wobble and drift a bit but they too found the portal or? I have a keen interest in aircraft and especially military varieties and have attended many air show demonstrations and static displays and I can tell you no humans could dream of holding a formation anywhere near as precise as what we observed this evening. I don’t know what the hell we saw! Any light shed upon this mystery would be greatly appreciated, thank you.
